environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a fixed-response action rule that appends response headers via a Lambda@Edge-equivalent mechanism (ALB action type 'fixed-response' is not used; instead, a lightweight Envoy sidecar proxy in the task definition intercepts egress on port 8080 and injects headers). The Envoy sidecar applies a Lua filter that adds Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self' to all responses. Additionally, the LDAP server runs OpenLDAP 2.6 with the ppolicy overlay and a custom ACL: 'access to attrs=userPassword by self write by anonymous auth by * none' which prevents the service account from reading userPassword attributes. The OpenLDAP instance also has a slapo-constraint overlay configured with a regex constraint on search filters that rejects any filter containing parentheses-star patterns like '(uid=*)' when the bound DN is the service account, enforced via the constraint_attribute directive with a URI restriction limiting uid filter values to alphanumeric characters only: 'constraint_attribute uid regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$'.

config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Go 1.21, amd64, Envoy 1.28 sidecar
config.network: ALB -> Envoy:8443 -> container:8080, LDAP on internal VPC port 389
config.envoy_lua_filter: adds CSP header: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'
config.ldap_version: OpenLDAP 2.6 with ppolicy and constraint overlays
config.ldap_acl: access to attrs=userPassword by self write by anonymous auth by * none
config.ldap_constraint: constraint_attribute uid regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$ - rejects non-alphanumeric uid filter values at server level
